Daily Devotional

September 21

1 Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not. 2 Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is. (1 John 3:1-2 KJV)

What an amazing thing God has done, to not only forgive us of our sins and bring us back into fellowship with Him, but to adopt us as sons. Being a son of God means that we are heirs of God as is Jesus (Romans 8:17), and that is hard for us born again Christians to get our minds wrapped around. It would have been wonderful to just be forgiven our sins, but to be adopted as sons, is beyond our expectations. If we are living our Christian lives, as we should, then the world will not understand us any better then it understood Jesus (John 15:20). If you are liked and understood by all the people in this world, then you are not letting Jesus live through you, as Paul said we should.

We have the promise of our bodies becoming like Jesus is now, and when we see Him face to face, we will be like Him, and know all things as He does (1 Corinthians 13:12). The Christian should certainly look forward to the day when we see Jesus, as it will be such a glorious time, to not only be with Him, but to begin our lives in a incorruptible body with Jesus and the Father forever – Hallelujah!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
